Summarise the supplied source text in at most 100 words. Be concise and objective.
Report only information supported by the source. Attribute claims, opinions, and
projections to their authors or speakers, and preserve uncertainty and
qualifications; do not present disputed claims as established facts. Do not add

summary: On Australia’s Q+A, investor representative Zoe Whitton questioned whether investors would fund a gas-led recovery and warned that future export demand could weaken. Senator Matt Canavan disagreed, citing global investment in gas and attributing Australia’s difficulties to high production costs. Essayist Eric Worrall argued that Australia’s energy policies send incoherent signals to investors, citing restrictions on gas exploration and support for hydrogen. Victoria announced it would lift its onshore conventional gas exploration moratorium while seeking to enshrine bans on fracking and coal seam gas exploration in its constitution.
